title: Sheet-Pan Chicken & Potatoes
description: Juicy seasoned chicken thighs roast with tender potatoes and broccoli on one tray.
ingredients: 1 large head broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss halved potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil and some of the salt; roast on a sheet pan 15 minutes.
Season chicken with 1 tbsp olive oil, paprika, oregano, garlic powder and pepper. Add to the pan and roast 10 minutes.
Toss broccoli with remaining olive oil and salt; add to pan and roast another 12–15 minutes, until potatoes are tender and chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) internally.
